notes: No library files were modified. Full HF zero-centered RMSNorm vectors need +1 before casting to reduced precision.
Depthwise Conv1d uses [out, kernel, 1], patch Conv3d uses [out, temporal, height, width, in]. Existing sanitize handles both.
mRoPE position IDs match PyTorch exactly. MLX fp32 hidden states closely match fresh PyTorch fp32.
Stored reference came from the documented transformers 5.4.0 baseline. Installed transformers is now 5.20.2, torch 2.14.1.
Version drift is confirmed, but its causal contribution to the stored-reference mismatch was not isolated. The stored gate was not changed.
Current snapshot CPU default uses bf16 autocast with fp32 stored parameters. The explicit fp32 hidden export disables autocast.
